title: Lecturer in Sustainable Agriculture
summary: IAU is seeking a lecturer to teach undergraduate modules in sustainable agriculture and support research across the faculty.
description:
The International Agriculture University invites applications for a Lecturer in Sustainable Agriculture. The successful candidate will deliver lectures and seminars, supervise student projects, and contribute to curriculum development in line with IAU’s science-based, practice-oriented mission.

You will work closely with faculty colleagues and international partners, including the Royal Agricultural University (UK), to strengthen teaching quality and applied research.
requirements:
PhD or Master’s degree in agriculture, agronomy, or a closely related field.
Teaching experience at university level is an advantage.
English language proficiency sufficient for teaching.
Commitment to student-centred, practice-oriented education.

title: HR Specialist
summary: Join the university administration team to support recruitment, staff records, and day-to-day HR processes.
description:
IAU is looking for an HR Specialist to support recruitment, onboarding, and personnel administration. The role includes coordinating vacancy announcements, maintaining staff records, and assisting departments with HR procedures.

This is an opportunity to work in an international academic environment and contribute to a growing university team.
requirements:
Higher education in HR, management, or a related field.
Experience in human resources or office administration.
Strong communication skills in Uzbek and Russian; English is an advantage.
Confidence with MS Office and document management.
